name: Um er-Rasas (Kastrom Mefa'a)
description: Um er-Rasas is a ruined desert town in central Jordan, about 30 km southeast of Madaba. It began as a Roman military camp and grew into a Byzantine and early Muslim settlement, and most of it still lies unexcavated. Visitors come for its 16 churches, especially the Church of Saint Stephen's mosaic floor of regional towns, and a lone square tower once used by hermit monks.
